label: complementary
rationale: The PIGS_NP predicate 'at' describes the location of an entity, while the PUSS predicate 'castle_owned_by' describes ownership of a location. These predicates represent fundamentally different aspects of the world: spatial location versus ownership. The 'at' predicate is used to specify where an entity is, while 'castle_owned_by' specifies which entity controls a castle. The action contexts for 'at' consistently use it to describe the location of entities, whereas the 'castle_owned_by' predicate is used in the context of defining ownership relationships. The predicates are complementary because they describe distinct properties of the world. The arguments '?e' and '?l' in 'at' represent an entity and a location, respectively, while '?castle' and '?owner' in 'castle_owned_by' represent a location and an entity, respectively. The use of 'at' is focused on spatial positioning, while 'castle_owned_by' is focused on establishing a relationship of control over a location. The different action contexts further reinforce this distinction. The 'at' actions describe where entities are, while the 'castle_owned_by' action describes the owner of a castle. The predicates are not interchangeable because they describe different aspects of the world.
